steps.command:
set -eu
        install -d -o root -g root -m 1777 /var/tmp/inventory
        printf '%s
' expired > /var/tmp/inventory/expired.tmp
        printf '%s
' current > /var/tmp/inventory/current.tmp
        touch -t 202001010000 /var/tmp/inventory/expired.tmp
        touch /var/tmp/inventory/current.tmp
steps.stderr: install: cannot change owner and permissions of ‘/var/tmp/inventory’: Operation not permitted
